```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(icesTAF)
library(FLCore)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_bw())

stockcode <- "hom.27.4bc7d"

FIG_DIR <- "report/figures_compositions"
mkdir("report")
mkdir(FIG_DIR)

save_and_show <- function(p, filename, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300) {
  path <- file.path(FIG_DIR, filename)
  if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  } else {
    png(path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi, bg = "white")
    on.exit(dev.off())
    p()
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}
```

# Length at age (`r currentYear`)

```{r lena-parse}
# Generic parser for the repeated "<title> by Area" blocks in the InterCatch
# CatchAndSampleDataTables.txt export. Table length is detected from the file
# itself (first blank/non-tabular line) rather than assumed from a fixed age
# range, and the "All periods" (or a given quarter) sub-table is located by
# matching its preceding "For Period" line rather than a hardcoded position.
extract_area_table <- function(lines, title, period = "All periods", fallback_occurrence = 5) {
  starts <- grep(title, lines, fixed = TRUE)
  if (length(starts) == 0) return(NULL)
  sel <- starts[vapply(starts, function(i) {
    ctx <- lines[max(1, i - 6):max(1, i - 1)]
    any(grepl(paste0("For Period\\t", period), ctx))
  }, logical(1))]
  start <- if (length(sel) > 0) sel[1] else starts[min(fallback_occurrence, length(starts))]

  header <- strsplit(lines[start + 3], "\t")[[1]]
  body <- character(0)
  j <- start + 4
  while (j <= length(lines) && grepl("\t", lines[j]) && nchar(trimws(lines[j])) > 0) {
    body <- c(body, lines[j])
    j <- j + 1
  }
  if (length(body) == 0) return(NULL)

  rows <- strsplit(body, "\t")
  age  <- vapply(rows, `[`, character(1), 1)
  vals <- lapply(rows, function(r) as.numeric(gsub(",", "", r[-1])))
  df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, vals))
  names(df) <- header[-1]
  df$age <- as.numeric(age)
  df
}

catch_file <- list.files(taf.data.path(), pattern = "CatchAndSampleDataTables", full.names = TRUE)[1]
catch_lines <- scan(catch_file, what = character(), sep = "\n", quiet = TRUE)

pad_ages <- function(df) {
  full <- data.frame(age = minAge:maxAge)
  out  <- left_join(full, df, by = "age")
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  out$year <- currentYear
  out
}

lena_area  <- pad_ages(extract_area_table(catch_lines, "Mean Length at Age by Area"))
canum_area <- pad_ages(extract_area_table(catch_lines, "Catch Numbers at Age by Area"))
weca_area  <- pad_ages(extract_area_table(catch_lines, "Mean Weight at Age by Area"))

write.csv(lena_area,  "report/lena_area.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(canum_area, "report/canum_area.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(weca_area,  "report/weca_area.csv",  row.names = FALSE)

area_cols <- setdiff(names(lena_area), c("age", "year", "Total"))
```

```{r lena-table}
kable(lena_area[, c("age", area_cols, "Total")], caption = paste("Mean length at age (cm) by area,", currentYear), digits = 1, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r lena-plot}

p_lena <- ggplot(lena_long, aes(age, length, colour = area)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Mean length (cm)", colour = "Area",
       title = paste0("Mean length at age (", currentYear, ")"))

save_and_show(p_lena, "mean_length_at_age.png")
```

# Length frequency distribution of the catch {.tabset}

```{r lenfreq-load}
# Picks up every "NSHOM_lengthData_<year>.csv" file present in data/ (one raw
# InterCatch length-frequency export per year) - add a new year's file and it
# shows up here automatically, nothing to edit.
lenfreq_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "^NSHOM_lengthData_[0-9]{4}\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

lenfreq_df <- bind_rows(lapply(lenfreq_files, read.csv))
lenfreq_df$Year <- factor(lenfreq_df$Year)
lenfreq_df$category <- recode(lenfreq_df$CatchCategory,
                               L = "Landings", D = "Discards",
                               C = "Catch (combined)", BMS = "BMS landing")

# reusable builders, parameterised by a pre-filtered (by origin) data frame and
# a filename suffix - each origin tab below just calls these once, rather than
# repeating the plotting code per origin
plot_lenfreq_by_year <- function(df, suffix) {
  d <- df %>% group_by(Year, Length_cm) %>%
    summarise(NumberCaught = sum(NumberCaught, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Length_cm, NumberCaught)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue4") +
    facet_wrap(~Year, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Length (cm)", y = "Number caught (raised)",
         title = paste(stockcode, "- length frequency by year"))
  save_and_show(p, paste0("length_frequency_by_year_", suffix, ".png"),
                height = 2.5 * length(unique(d$Year)))
}

plot_lenfreq_by_category <- function(df, suffix) {
  d <- df %>% group_by(Year, category, Length_cm) %>%
    summarise(NumberCaught = sum(NumberCaught, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Length_cm, NumberCaught, fill = Year)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Length (cm)", y = "Number caught (raised)", fill = NULL,
         title = "Length frequency by catch category")
  save_and_show(p, paste0("length_frequency_by_category_", suffix, ".png"))
}

plot_lenfreq_by_fleet <- function(df, suffix) {
  d <- df %>% group_by(Year, Fleet, Length_cm) %>%
    summarise(NumberCaught = sum(NumberCaught, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  n_fleet <- length(unique(d$Fleet))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Length_cm, NumberCaught, fill = Year)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    facet_wrap(~Fleet, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Length (cm)", y = "Number caught (raised)", fill = NULL,
         title = "Length frequency by fleet") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  save_and_show(p, paste0("length_frequency_by_fleet_", suffix, ".png"),
                width = min(14, 4 * n_fleet), height = 3 + 2 * (n_fleet %/% 4))
}

table_lenfreq_summary <- function(df) {
  s <- df %>% group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      `Mean length (cm)`  = round(weighted.mean(Length_cm, NumberCaught, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      `Length range (cm)` = paste(min(Length_cm), "-", max(Length_cm)),
      `N length measurements` = sum(NumLngtMeas, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  kable(s, caption = "Length sampling summary by year", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# Catch curves and total mortality by cohort

```{r catch-curves-setup}
# a cohort needs several years of observed ages to fit a reliable slope;
# 8 years mirrors the cutoff used in past editions of this report, kept here
# as a relative offset so it scales forward
minCohortSpan   <- 8
startYearCohort <- startYr
endYearCohort   <- endYr - minCohortSpan
stkCohort <- FLCohort(log(NSHOM@catch.n))
```

```{r catch-curves-plot}
save_and_show(
  function() print(FLCore::plot(stkCohort[, as.character(startYearCohort:endYearCohort)])),
  "catch_curves_by_cohort.png"
)
```

```{r catch-curves-slope}
coh  <- startYearCohort:endYearCohort
data_coh <- as.data.frame(stkCohort)

slope_df <- bind_rows(lapply(coh, function(cy) {
  datsel <- data_coh[data_coh$cohort == cy & !is.na(data_coh$data) & data_coh$data > 0, ]
  if (nrow(datsel) < 2) return(NULL)
  fit <- lm(log(data) ~ age, data = datsel)
  data.frame(cohort = cy, Z = -coef(fit)[["age"]])
}))

p_slope <- ggplot(slope_df, aes(cohort, Z)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Cohort", y = "Total mortality Z",
       title = "Total mortality by cohort (catch curve slope)")

save_and_show(p_slope, "catch_curves_by_cohort_slope.png")
write.csv(drop(stkCohort), "report/catch_at_age_cohort.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
